test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Graphology tells them about the candidates’ temperaments, highlighting both, weaknesses and strengths.

B. Many companies use it for executive recruitment and analysis.

C. Despite public scepticism, graphology plays a covert role in British management.

D. Modern graphology began early in the 19th century when French churchman Jean Hippolyte Michon created the first graphological ‘catalogue’.
solution:
The correct answer is '**DCBA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sentence D** provides the historical context of modern graphology.
 
• **Sentence C** highlights the public perception of graphology, while also hinting at its covert use in British management.
 
• **Sentence B** explains the practical application of graphology in executive recruitment and analysis.
 
• **Sentence A** further elaborates on the benefits of using graphology in evaluating candidates.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (ABCD)**: This arrangement reverses the logical flow of the paragraph, starting with the practical application of graphology before providing historical and contextual information.
 
• **Option 3 (ABDC)**: This arrangement places sentence A before sentence B, which disrupts the logical flow of the paragraph and creates confusion.
 
• **Option 4 (CBDA)**: This arrangement places sentence C at the beginning, which does not provide any context for the reader and makes the paragraph seem disjointed.
